intro.zh: LumiaKey 将手机或平板变成电脑快捷键控制面板，提供键盘操作、媒体控制、触控输入和本地语音识别。本说明书面向首次使用者，介绍移动端与 LumiaKey Desktop 的功能及操作条件。
intro.en: LumiaKey turns a phone or tablet into a computer shortcut panel with keyboard actions, media controls, touch input and local speech recognition. This guide helps new users understand the mobile app, LumiaKey Desktop and the requirements for each feature.

paragraphs.zh: 适用版本 1.3.0+5，对应 2026 年 11 月 10 日的双模式更新（d01db29）。应用界面主要为英文，中文说明保留屏幕上的英文按钮名称。识别语言与界面语言分别设置。
paragraphs.en: This guide covers version 1.3.0+5 with the computer modes update of 10 November 2026 (d01db29). The interface is primarily English. Recognition language is configured separately.

paragraphs.zh: 截图来自新版应用的 Flutter 界面测试。连接、已安装应用、按键、统计与听写状态均使用示例数据。
paragraphs.en: Screenshots show the current Flutter interface in tests. Connections, installed apps, key bindings, usage counts and dictation states use sample data.

zh: 支持蓝牙 HID Device 的 Android 9 或更新设备
与电脑蓝牙配对，使用每台电脑的设置向导配置应用快捷键
en: Android 9 or later with Bluetooth HID Device support
Pair over Bluetooth and set up app shortcuts for each computer

zh: Windows 或 macOS 运行 LumiaKey Desktop，双方在同一局域网。连通后自动启用。
en: Run LumiaKey Desktop on Windows or macOS. Advanced mode starts automatically when it connects over the local network.

caption.zh: 图 1 手机横屏 General 默认布局，右侧为触控板
caption.en: Figure 1 Default General profile in landscape with the touchpad on the right

intro.zh: Android 可通过蓝牙直连电脑，也可连接同一局域网内的 LumiaKey Desktop。两者同时连接时，应用区优先进入 Desktop 高级模式。iPhone 和 iPad 的配对步骤见后面的 iOS 章节。
intro.en: Android can connect over Bluetooth or through LumiaKey Desktop on the same local network. When both are connected, the app uses Desktop advanced mode for application shortcuts. See the iOS section for iPhone and iPad pairing.

steps.zh: 蓝牙直连时，从 Android 右上角状态菜单或 Settings → Computer connection 打开蓝牙面板。授予“附近的设备”权限，然后选择 Make discoverable。
steps.en: For Bluetooth only, open the connection panel from the Android status menu or Settings → Computer connection. Grant Nearby devices access and choose Make discoverable.

steps.zh: 在电脑蓝牙设置中配对手机。回到 LumiaKey 刷新列表，再点电脑旁的 Connect。首次连接该电脑时进入应用设置向导。
steps.en: Pair the phone in the computer’s Bluetooth settings. Return to LumiaKey, refresh the list and tap Connect next to the computer. The first connection opens its app setup wizard.

steps.zh: 高级模式下，在电脑启动 LumiaKey Desktop，从 Windows 托盘或 macOS 菜单栏打开 Open Settings。将手机和电脑接入同一局域网，在手机的 Settings → Desktop Companion 查看连接状态。
steps.en: For advanced mode, start LumiaKey Desktop and choose Open Settings in the Windows tray or macOS menu bar. Put both devices on the same local network and check Settings → Desktop Companion on the phone.

caption.zh: 图 2 蓝牙连接面板，电脑名称为示例
caption.en: Figure 2 Bluetooth connection panel with a sample computer

caption.zh: 图 3 Settings 与 Desktop Companion 区域
caption.en: Figure 3 Settings and the Desktop Companion section

intro.zh: 首次连接某台电脑时，选择要放在首页顶部的应用。选择和快捷键按电脑保存，稍后可用应用栏右侧的设置图标修改。
intro.en: On the first connection to a computer, choose the apps to show in the top row. App choices and bindings are saved for that computer. Use the settings icon at the right of the app row to change them later.

steps.zh: 在应用列表勾选常用软件，例如 Chrome、Teams、Zoom、Codex、Claude 或 Cursor。只用通用控制时，保持列表空白并选择 Use General only。
steps.en: Select the apps you use, such as Chrome, Teams, Zoom, Codex, Claude or Cursor. For general controls only, leave the list empty and choose Use General only.

steps.zh: 在 Desktop 高级模式下，从检测到的应用中选择，再点 Use Desktop apps。快捷键由 Desktop 提供。
steps.en: In Desktop advanced mode, choose from the detected apps and tap Use Desktop apps. Desktop provides the bindings.

steps.zh: 在 Android 蓝牙直连模式下，展开每个已选应用，填写 Launch app 和所需的动作组合键。会议应用填写静音、摄像头和举手。Vibe Coding 的动作见第 9 节。
steps.en: In Bluetooth mode on Android, expand each selected app and enter its Launch app shortcut and required action keys. Meeting apps ask for microphone, camera and raise-hand shortcuts. See section 9 for the Vibe Coding actions.

caption.zh: 图 4 选择这台电脑的应用
caption.en: Figure 4 Choose apps for this computer

caption.zh: 图 5 填写应用快捷键
caption.en: Figure 5 Enter app shortcuts

intro.zh: 蓝牙直连通过电脑上的全局快捷键启动应用。先在电脑上设置，再把同一组合键填入 LumiaKey 的 Launch app。
intro.en: Bluetooth mode launches an app through a global shortcut configured on the computer. Set it there first, then enter the same key combination under Launch app in LumiaKey.

steps.zh: Windows 在开始菜单或桌面找到应用快捷方式，打开 Properties 并设置 Shortcut key。macOS 可在 Shortcuts 创建 Open App 动作，再用 Add Keyboard Shortcut 设置组合键。
steps.en: On Windows, open Properties for the app shortcut in Start or on the desktop and set its Shortcut key. On macOS, create an Open App action in Shortcuts and choose Add Keyboard Shortcut.

steps.zh: 先把目标应用切到后台或关闭，再在手机点 Test app launch shortcut。看到应用打开或切到前台后，勾选 I saw this app open。修改启动键后要重新测试。
steps.en: Switch away from the target app or close it, then tap Test app launch shortcut on the phone. When the app opens or comes forward, select I saw this app open. Test again whenever you change its launch key.

steps.zh: 为每个已选应用完成测试并填好必需快捷键，再点 Save settings。首页应用栏会显示这些软件。
steps.en: Test every selected app and fill in its required shortcuts. Tap Save settings to add the apps to the home row.

caption.zh: 图 6 确认电脑上的应用已打开
caption.en: Figure 6 Confirm the app opened on the computer

intro.zh: iPhone 和 iPad 需先配对 LumiaKey Desktop 才能进入控制界面。电脑和移动设备需在同一局域网。
intro.en: An iPhone or iPad must pair with LumiaKey Desktop before it can show the shortcut controls. Put both devices on the same local network.

steps.zh: 在 Windows 或 macOS 运行 LumiaKey Desktop，打开 Connect an iPhone or iPad 面板，选择 iPhone 或 iPad 可以访问的局域网地址，再点 Copy iPhone / iPad connection code。
steps.en: Run LumiaKey Desktop on Windows or macOS. In Connect an iPhone or iPad, select an address reachable by the device and choose Copy iPhone / iPad connection code.

steps.zh: 在 iPhone 或 iPad 打开 LumiaKey，将连接码粘贴到 Desktop connection code，点 Connect。系统提示时允许“本地网络”访问。
steps.en: Open LumiaKey on the iPhone or iPad. Paste the code into Desktop connection code and tap Connect. Allow Local Network access if prompted.

steps.zh: 首次配对成功后，在向导选择电脑应用并保存。Desktop 重启或旧连接失效时，从电脑端复制新码再配对。
steps.en: After the first successful pairing, choose the computer’s apps in the wizard and save. If Desktop restarts or the connection expires, copy a fresh code and pair again.

paragraphs.zh: 连接码包含临时凭据，请妥善保管。局域网通信经过认证，使用未加密的 HTTP，请在可信网络上配对。
paragraphs.en: The code contains a temporary credential. Keep it private. Local communication authenticates requests over unencrypted HTTP, so pair on a trusted network.

caption.zh: 图 7 iPad 初次打开时的配对页，连接码为空
caption.en: Figure 7 First-launch iPad pairing screen with an empty code field

intro.zh: 手机控制模式一页最多显示 15 个快捷键，竖屏为 3 列 5 行，横屏为 5 列 3 行。旋转屏幕会释放已按住的按键，布局变化保留当前配置。
intro.en: Phone controls show up to 15 shortcuts per bank: three columns by five rows in portrait and five columns by three rows in landscape. Rotation releases held keys while preserving the active configuration.

paragraphs.zh: General 默认按钮包括静音、音量、撤销、重做、上一首、播放暂停、下一首、打开、Dark、剪切、复制、粘贴、关闭和删除。目标程序需要处于合适的焦点状态，实际快捷键效果由目标程序决定。Dark 会调暗手机，并在 Desktop 可用时请求电脑亮度控制；电脑效果取决于平台支持。
paragraphs.en: General includes mute, volume, undo, redo, previous track, play/pause, next track, open, Dark, cut, copy, paste, close and delete. Keep the intended app focused; shortcut behavior depends on that app. Dark dims the phone and requests host brightness control when Desktop is available; host effects depend on platform support.

paragraphs.zh: 在 Android 蓝牙触控板上，单指滑动移动指针，轻点左键，双指滑动滚动，双指轻点右键。右侧滚动带支持单指滚动。其他配置可使用可编辑导航轮。iOS 通过 Desktop 发送受支持的键盘快捷键。
paragraphs.en: On the Android Bluetooth touchpad, drag one finger to move the pointer, tap for left-click, slide two fingers to scroll and tap two fingers for right-click. The right-edge strip supports one-finger scrolling. Other profiles can use an editable navigation wheel. iOS sends supported keyboard shortcuts through Desktop.

paragraphs.zh: Settings → Control Surface 可选 Automatic、Phone controls 或 Shortcut board。Automatic 在窗口最短边达到 600 逻辑像素时显示平板键盘板；窄分屏会切回手机模式。
paragraphs.en: Settings → Control Surface offers Automatic, Phone controls and Shortcut board. Automatic uses the board when the window’s shortest side reaches 600 logical pixels; narrow split views return to phone controls.

paragraphs.zh: Shortcut board keys per screen 可设 24 至 60 的任意整数，默认 40。键盘板不占用空间显示触控板或导航轮；使用分页控件浏览其他 bank。旧 15 键配置保留，编辑空位后才添加新按键。
paragraphs.en: Shortcut board keys per screen accepts any integer from 24 to 60, with 40 as the default. The board omits the touchpad and wheel. Use page controls for other banks. Existing 15-key profiles stay intact; editing an unused slot adds a key.

caption.zh: 图 8 平板 40 键布局，未配置的位置保留为空位
caption.en: Figure 8 Tablet board with 40 slots; unused positions remain unconfigured

intro.zh: Profile 保存一组按钮、图标和导航操作。初始本地配置为 General、Web、Zoom / Teams 和 Custom，免费版本最多保留四个本地 Profile。
intro.en: A Profile stores buttons, visuals and navigation actions. The initial local profiles are General, Web, Zoom / Teams and Custom. The free edition supports up to four local profiles.

steps.zh: 在应用栏下方切换可见的 Profile。连接电脑后，浏览器和会议软件从顶部应用栏进入。Settings → Profiles 可创建、复制、编辑、排序、删除、设为默认或恢复模板。槽位已满时导入需要选择替换。
steps.en: Switch visible profiles below the app row. Once connected, open browsers and meeting apps from the top row. Settings → Profiles lets you create, copy, edit, reorder, delete, set a default or restore a template. Importing at capacity requires choosing a replacement slot.

steps.zh: 右上角菜单选择 Edit buttons，再点目标按钮。设置名称、图标或自定义图片、动作与反馈，保存后退出编辑模式。编辑模式下长按拖动到另一个按钮可交换完整配置。
steps.en: Choose Edit buttons from the top-right menu, then tap a button. Set its label, icon or image, action and feedback, save, then leave edit mode. Long-press and drag onto another button to swap their complete configurations.

steps.zh: 跨平台快捷键中的 PRIMARY 在 Apple 电脑映射为 Command，在 Windows 或 Linux 映射为 Ctrl。自动识别不正确时，到 Settings → Shortcut Platform 手动指定。
steps.en: PRIMARY maps to Command on Apple hosts and Ctrl on Windows or Linux. If automatic detection is incorrect, set the host platform manually in Settings → Shortcut Platform.

paragraphs.zh: 桌面托管的应用布局应在 Desktop → Shortcut Layout 编辑。手机 Profile JSON 导入会拒绝 Desktop Companion 动作；桌面布局与手机蓝牙 Profile 不可当作同一种文件互换。
paragraphs.en: Edit Desktop-managed app layouts in Desktop → Shortcut Layout. Phone Profile JSON import rejects Companion actions. Desktop layouts and phone Bluetooth profiles are different transfer formats.

caption.zh: 图 9 Profile 管理示例
caption.en: Figure 9 Profile management with a sample list

caption.zh: 图 10 按钮动作编辑区域
caption.en: Figure 10 Button action editor

intro.zh: 按钮可以显示文字、内置语义图标或自定义 PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片。Shortcut Community 提供内置离线配置包，以及通过剪贴板或文件交换 Profile 的入口。
intro.en: Buttons can display text, built-in semantic icons or custom PNG, JPEG and WebP images. Shortcut Community provides curated offline packs and Profile exchange through the clipboard or files.

steps.zh: 在按钮编辑器打开图标选择器，按关键词搜索或按分类筛选；可使用最近选择、收藏、预览、尺寸和颜色设置。自定义图片会复制到应用私有目录，可调整适配、缩放、位置和文字覆盖。
steps.en: Open the icon picker from the button editor. Search by keyword or filter by category; use recent choices, favorites, preview, size and color controls. Custom images are copied into app-private storage and support fit, scale, position and label overlays.

steps.zh: 打开 Settings → Shortcut Community，选择内置包，或粘贴／导入 Profile JSON。查看预览并确认替换槽位；未确认前不会覆盖当前配置。
steps.en: Open Settings → Shortcut Community, choose a built-in pack or paste/import Profile JSON. Review it and confirm the replacement slot before changing the current configuration.

steps.zh: 使用 Copy active Profile JSON 复制配置，或导出 .smartkeys.json 文件。私有图片文件不会因复制 JSON 自动传到另一台设备；跨设备恢复图片可使用包含图片的账户备份。
steps.en: Use Copy active Profile JSON or export a .smartkeys.json file. Copying JSON does not transfer private image files to another device; use an account backup that includes images when needed.

paragraphs.zh: 图片缺失时显示明确占位符，需重新导入或从备份恢复。这里的离线配置包与在线使用排行榜是不同功能；使用离线包不需要部署社区服务器。
paragraphs.en: Missing images display a placeholder and must be reimported or restored. Offline packs and online usage rankings are separate features; offline packs do not require a community server.

caption.zh: 图 11 内置图标选择器
caption.en: Figure 11 Built-in icon picker

caption.zh: 图 12 离线配置包与 JSON 交换
caption.en: Figure 12 Offline packs and JSON exchange

intro.zh: 首页最顶一排显示为当前电脑选定的应用。点击某个应用，电脑启动或切换到该应用，手机打开对应的快捷键界面。
intro.en: The top row shows the apps selected for the current computer. Tap an app to launch or focus it on the computer and open its shortcut controls on mobile.

paragraphs.zh: 蓝牙直连使用向导里保存的启动键和动作键。使用动作键时，请确认目标应用在电脑前台。
paragraphs.en: Bluetooth mode uses the launch and action shortcuts saved in the wizard. Keep the intended app in front when sending a shortcut.

paragraphs.zh: 高级模式下，在 Desktop 的 General 中启用 Enable Apps Sync 和 Auto Launch Apps。应用栏显示已选且检测到的应用，快捷键来自电脑端布局。
paragraphs.en: In advanced mode, turn on Enable Apps Sync and Auto Launch Apps under Desktop → General. The row shows selected apps that Desktop detects and uses their managed layouts.

paragraphs.zh: 浏览器布局可用来切换标签页、导航和刷新。Teams 与 Zoom 的布局提供会议麦克风、摄像头和举手等操作。应用或快捷键的可用性取决于电脑平台及所装版本。
paragraphs.en: Browser layouts offer tab switching, navigation and refresh. Teams and Zoom layouts include meeting controls for the microphone, camera and raising a hand. App and shortcut availability depends on the computer platform and installed version.

caption.zh: 图 13 高级模式 General 页顶部的应用栏
caption.en: Figure 13 Selected apps above General in advanced mode

intro.zh: 先在向导选择 Codex、Claude 或 Cursor，再用顶部应用栏启动或切换软件。Vibe Coding 是共用入口，面板显示当前所选应用的按键。
intro.en: Select Codex, Claude or Cursor in setup, then use the top app row to launch or switch apps. The single Vibe Coding tab shows the keys for the selected app.

paragraphs.zh: 蓝牙直连时，设置 Start voice mode、Start voice input、Cancel or clear、Previous conversation、Next conversation 和 Next project。两个语音动作需填写不同的组合键。按键会发送电脑应用的快捷键。
paragraphs.en: In Bluetooth mode, configure Start voice mode, Start voice input, Cancel or clear, Previous conversation, Next conversation and Next project. Use different chords for the two voice actions. The buttons send the configured computer shortcuts.

paragraphs.zh: 在高级模式下，将目标应用切到前台，再使用 Local Dictation 的 Start 或 Stop。语音在移动设备识别，最终文字经 Desktop 输出。首次使用按提示配置本地模型。
paragraphs.en: In advanced mode, bring the target app to the front, then use Start or Stop under Local Dictation. The mobile device recognizes speech locally and Desktop delivers the final text. Follow the setup prompt for the local model on first use.

paragraphs.zh: 高级布局还提供项目、对话、发送、退格、剪贴板、标点和区域截图等操作。项目按钮的行为随应用而异。Codex 打开项目选择器，Claude 在新建 Code 会话时选择文件夹，Cursor 通过命令面板打开文件夹或最近项目。
paragraphs.en: Advanced layouts also include project, chat, send, backspace, clipboard, punctuation and region screenshot controls. Codex opens its project picker. Claude lets you choose a folder in a new Code session. Cursor opens the command palette for folders or recent projects.

caption.zh: 图 14 蓝牙直连的 Vibe Coding 按键
caption.en: Figure 14 Vibe Coding over Bluetooth

caption.zh: 图 15 高级模式的本地听写控件
caption.en: Figure 15 Advanced mode with Local Dictation

intro.zh: LumiaKey Desktop 启动后位于系统托盘或菜单栏。选择 Open Settings 打开窗口；关闭设置窗口会隐藏应用，选择 Quit 才退出。
intro.en: LumiaKey Desktop starts in the system tray or menu bar. Choose Open Settings to show its window. Closing settings hides the app; choose Quit to exit.

paragraphs.zh: General 管理 Enable Apps Sync、Auto Launch Apps、Sync Icons 及当前连接手机／配置；Bluetooth 查看连接提示；Apps 检测支持的已安装程序并刷新运行状态；Profiles 管理桌面配置；About 显示产品信息。
paragraphs.en: General manages Enable Apps Sync, Auto Launch Apps, Sync Icons and the current phone/profile. Bluetooth shows connection guidance. Apps detects supported installed programs and refreshes running state. Profiles manages Desktop profiles; About shows product information.

paragraphs.zh: 截图处于未连接示例状态。若实际使用时出现 Sync service unavailable，先检查 Desktop 服务、系统防火墙及局域网连接；No phone connected 表示当前没有手机会话。
paragraphs.en: The screenshot shows a disconnected example. If Sync service unavailable appears during use, check the Desktop service, firewall and LAN connection. No phone connected means there is no active phone session.

caption.zh: 图 16 Desktop General 设置，示例未启动同步服务
caption.en: Figure 16 Desktop General settings with synchronization inactive in the test

intro.zh: 桌面应用布局由 Desktop 管理并同步至手机。编辑前选择正确的应用与布局，保存后使用目标程序核对效果。
intro.en: Desktop owns app layouts and synchronizes them to mobile. Select the correct app and layout before editing, then verify the saved result in the target app.

paragraphs.zh: 在 Shortcut Layout 选择应用和按钮，编辑 Button Name、Icon、Target Type、Shortcut、Launch App、URL 和 Description。当前可执行 Keyboard Shortcut、Launch Application 和 Open URL；Macro 与 Script 暂不可执行。
paragraphs.en: In Shortcut Layout, select an app and button, then edit Button Name, Icon, Target Type, Shortcut, Launch App, URL and Description. Keyboard Shortcut, Launch Application and Open URL are executable; Macro and Script are currently unavailable.

paragraphs.zh: 桌面布局 JSON 可导入／导出，导出会省略可执行文件数据。导入只替换已知布局并验证应用标识；运行路径由 Desktop 管理。手机发送按钮标识，由 Desktop 解析实际动作。
paragraphs.en: Desktop layout JSON can be imported and exported; exports omit executable data. Imports replace known layouts and validate app IDs. Desktop owns executable paths and resolves the button IDs sent by mobile into actions.

caption.zh: 图 17 Desktop 快捷键布局管理
caption.en: Figure 17 Desktop shortcut layout management

intro.zh: Local quick dictation 使用手机麦克风和本地模型识别语音。它与 Application voice input 波形按钮不同，后者只触发目标应用自己的语音快捷键。首次使用需要阅读并确认说明。
intro.en: Local quick dictation uses the phone’s microphone and a local recognition model. It differs from the Application voice input waveform button, which triggers the target app’s own voice shortcut. First use requires acknowledging the explanation.

steps.zh: 长按麦克风打开设置，选择输出、模型和识别语言，显式下载或导入模型。默认 SenseVoice Small 约 229 MiB；可选 Cohere Transcribe 约 2.7 GiB。模型通过大小和 SHA-256 校验后才可使用。
steps.en: Long-press the microphone to choose output, model and recognition language, then explicitly download or import a model. SenseVoice Small is the default at about 229 MiB; Cohere Transcribe is an optional model at about 2.7 GiB. Files must pass size and SHA-256 checks.

steps.zh: Bluetooth 输出仅支持英文，电脑应使用英文输入状态和美式键盘布局。中文或其他多语言文字必须选择 LumiaKey Desktop，并连接同一局域网内的 Desktop；不会自动切回蓝牙。
steps.en: Bluetooth output is English-only and requires English input with a US keyboard layout on the computer. For Chinese or other multilingual text, choose LumiaKey Desktop and connect it on the same LAN. There is no automatic Bluetooth fallback.

steps.zh: 模型与输出就绪后点按麦克风快速开始。听写时仍可使用快捷键；角落控制显示音量和 Stop。点击 Stop 停止；返回、进入设置、离开前台或连接变更会取消收音。
steps.en: When the model and output are ready, tap the microphone to start. Shortcuts remain usable while listening; the corner control shows the level and Stop. Stop ends capture. Back, settings, leaving the foreground or connection changes cancel capture.

paragraphs.zh: 音频只保留在有界内存，不写入录音文件或历史，也不发送给 Desktop。Desktop 模式仅发送最终识别文字。截图中的就绪与收音状态为测试示例，不代表实际模型下载或识别效果。
paragraphs.en: Audio stays in bounded memory and is neither saved as a recording/history nor sent to Desktop. Desktop mode sends finalized text only. Ready/listening screenshots use test states rather than evidence of a model download or recognition quality.

caption.zh: 图 18 多语言 Desktop 输出设置示例
caption.en: Figure 18 Multilingual Desktop output setup example

intro.zh: Desktop 也可独立使用电脑麦克风和本地模型听写，不需要手机收音。它将最终文字插入当前受支持的外部应用。
intro.en: Desktop can independently dictate with the computer’s microphone and a local model, without capturing audio on the phone. Final text is inserted into a supported focused external app.

steps.zh: 从托盘打开设置，进入 Local Dictation。选择模型和识别语言，下载或导入模型；下载不会自动开始。允许 Windows 隐私设置或 macOS 提示中的麦克风权限。
steps.en: Open settings from the tray and select Local Dictation. Choose a model and recognition language, then download or import the model. Downloads are explicit. Allow microphone access in Windows privacy settings or the macOS prompt.

steps.zh: 在目标应用中聚焦可输入的文本框。默认全局快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Space 启动或停止听写，也可用托盘 Start/Stop Local Dictation；快捷键可在设置里修改。
steps.en: Focus an editable field in the target app. The default global shortcut Ctrl+Shift+Space starts or stops dictation; the tray offers Start/Stop Local Dictation too. Change the shortcut in settings if needed.

steps.zh: macOS 文字插入还需要辅助功能与事件发送权限。若焦点不安全、目标改变或试图向 Desktop 自己的窗口输入，插入可能被拒绝；重新聚焦目标后显式重试。
steps.en: On macOS, text insertion also needs Accessibility and event-posting permission. Insertion can be rejected if focus is unsafe, the target changes or Desktop’s own window is targeted. Refocus the intended app and retry explicitly.

paragraphs.zh: 麦克风音频在本机内存处理，不保存录音。模型就绪不等于麦克风权限、识别准确率或目标程序文字插入已验证；首次使用应在可丢弃文本中确认输出。
paragraphs.en: Microphone audio is processed in local memory without saving recordings. Model readiness does not verify microphone permission, recognition accuracy or insertion into a particular app. Check the first output in disposable text.

title.zh: 14 使用统计与可选社区分享

intro.zh: Settings → Usage Dashboard 记录非空快捷键的点击尝试与时间。连接失败的点击也会计数，因此点击量并非成功执行次数。详细历史默认只留在本机。
intro.en: Settings → Usage Dashboard records nonempty shortcut click attempts and times. Failed or disconnected attempts also count, so clicks are not successful executions. Detailed history stays on the device by default.

paragraphs.zh: 可选择 All time、Today、7 days、30 days 或自定义日期，按使用量或最近使用排序，并查看逐次历史。Smart sort 需要主动触发，按累计使用量重排当前本地 Profile；不会重排 Desktop 托管布局。Clear local usage 需要确认。
paragraphs.en: Choose All time, Today, 7 days, 30 days or custom dates. Sort by usage or latest use and inspect individual events. Smart sort explicitly reorders the current local Profile by lifetime counts; it does not reorder Desktop-managed layouts. Clear local usage requires confirmation.

paragraphs.zh: 首次 Community setup 可选职业与电脑熟练度，也可 Skip for now。保存只保留本地默认值，不开启分享。Settings → Community sharing setup 可重新设置；每批提交仍需预览与确认。
paragraphs.en: First-launch Community setup offers optional profession and computer-proficiency tags, or Skip for now. Saving stores local defaults without enabling sharing. Reopen it through Settings → Community sharing setup. Every submission still requires preview and confirmation.

paragraphs.zh: 可选上报仅包含认可的标准类别与聚合数量，不上传自定义名称、具体时间或原始命令。公开排行榜无需分享即可查看，但需要已配置服务；至少三批贡献才展示类别，贡献批次不等于人数。撤回线上贡献与清除本机历史分别操作。可选服务还提供中文浏览器 Dashboard，展示公开数量、比例图和表格，支持时间、职业及熟练度筛选。
paragraphs.en: Optional submissions contain recognized standard categories and aggregate counts, excluding custom labels, exact times and raw commands. Rankings need a configured service but do not require sharing. Categories require three contribution batches; batches are not people. Online withdrawal and local clearing are separate. The optional service also offers a Chinese browser Dashboard with counts, a proportional chart, a table and period/profession/proficiency filters.

title.zh: 15 备份恢复与桌面安装包

intro.zh: 账户备份与社区分享相互独立。当前设置入口名称为 Google Drive backup，实际通过 Google 登录访问独立备份服务，并不把文件写到你的 Google Drive。
intro.en: Account backup is separate from community sharing. The settings entry currently says Google Drive backup, but Google sign-in accesses a separate backup service rather than storing files in your Google Drive.

paragraphs.zh: 配置服务和 Google OAuth 后，可登录、选择应用设置、指定 Profile 以及可选自定义图片，预览后手动备份。每个账户保存最新一份快照。恢复时选择项目并确认，Profile 总数仍受四个槽位限制，恢复不会执行快捷键。
paragraphs.en: Once the service and Google OAuth are configured, sign in, select app settings, Profiles and optional custom images, preview and back up manually. Each account stores its latest snapshot. Restore selected items within the four-profile limit; restoration does not execute shortcuts.

paragraphs.zh: 配对信息、点击历史、分享回执和登录凭据不进入备份。退出登录不会删除线上快照，需单独选择 Delete online backup。当前未配置构建会显示不可用提示，不提供模拟登录或虚构备份。
paragraphs.en: Pairing, click history, sharing receipts and login credentials are excluded. Signing out does not delete the online snapshot; use Delete online backup separately. An unconfigured build shows an unavailable message rather than simulated sign-in or fabricated backups.

paragraphs.zh: Android 的 Settings → Desktop installers 显示正式发布时内置的 Windows 安装器和 macOS DMG，可查看版本、来源提交、大小与 SHA-256 并验证。开发构建可能没有安装包。
paragraphs.en: On Android, Settings → Desktop installers shows the Windows installer and macOS DMG bundled in a release. Review version, source commit, size and SHA-256, and verify them. Development builds may contain no installers.

paragraphs.zh: 导出时在系统目录选择器选择共享存储位置，不覆盖已有文件；保存完成后校验大小与哈希。通过 USB 选择文件传输 MTP，将文件复制到电脑后安装；手机不会变成 USB 大容量磁盘。
paragraphs.en: Choose a shared-storage destination in the system folder picker. Export does not overwrite an existing file and verifies stored size and hash. Use USB file transfer/MTP to copy the package to the computer, then install it; the phone does not become a USB mass-storage drive.

intro.zh: Settings 可选择 Landscape、Portrait 或 Auto，默认横屏；还可设置充电亮度及保持唤醒行为。进行听写时保持唤醒，停止或取消听写后释放相应唤醒状态。
intro.en: Settings offers Landscape, Portrait and Auto, with landscape as the default, plus charging-brightness and wake options. Dictation keeps the screen awake while active and releases its wake state when stopped or cancelled.

paragraphs.zh: 蓝牙列表找不到电脑时，先完成系统配对，再刷新列表。Desktop 未连接时，确认双方在同一局域网、电脑端仍在运行且防火墙允许通信。iPhone 或 iPad 的连接失效后可重新复制连接码。
paragraphs.en: If a computer is missing from the Bluetooth list, pair it in system settings and refresh. For Desktop connection issues, check that both devices are on the same network, Desktop is running and the firewall allows access. Copy a fresh code if iPhone or iPad pairing expires.

paragraphs.zh: 应用未启动时，蓝牙直连应重新测试电脑的全局启动键。高级模式请检查 Enable Apps Sync 和 Auto Launch Apps。按键效果不符时，检查电脑前台、Shortcut Platform 和已保存的组合键。多语言听写需选择 LumiaKey Desktop 并确认连接。
paragraphs.en: If an app does not open, retest its global launch shortcut in Bluetooth mode, or check Enable Apps Sync and Auto Launch Apps in advanced mode. For an unexpected key action, check foreground focus, Shortcut Platform and the saved chord. Multilingual dictation needs a live LumiaKey Desktop connection.

paragraphs.zh: 模型或麦克风不可用：先完成模型校验，再检查系统麦克风权限；删除模型前会停止收音。排行榜或备份提示未配置：属于发布服务配置条件，仍可使用本机统计与离线配置，不代表有已上线服务。
paragraphs.en: Model or microphone unavailable: complete model verification and check system microphone permission. Deleting a model stops capture first. Unconfigured rankings or backup need release-service configuration; local statistics and offline profiles remain usable.

paragraphs.zh: 本说明书核对了源码和测试界面。Android 真机蓝牙输入、语音准确率与延迟、Windows/macOS 权限与文字输出，以及 iPhone/iPad 真机安装和配对需在对应设备上验证。
paragraphs.en: This guide checks source behavior and rendered test screens. Physical Android Bluetooth input, speech accuracy and latency, Windows/macOS permissions and text delivery, and iPhone/iPad installation and pairing need device testing.
